# Paws & Paths: instructions for GitHub Copilot

The team keeps one AI-assistant guide so the rules can't drift between tools. Read and follow
[`team-app/CLAUDE.md`](../team-app/CLAUDE.md): stack, directory layout, domain model, naming
conventions, design tokens, security rules, and git workflow. It also applies
[`team-app/AGENTS.md`](../team-app/AGENTS.md) (this Next.js version differs from older training data).

Sources of truth, in priority order: `.specify/memory/constitution.md`, then
`specs/001-paws-and-paths/spec.md`. The root [`CLAUDE.md`](../CLAUDE.md) adds the notes for
working from the repository root.
